Mawa Riverside

মাওয়া ঘাট

An old ferry landscape where riverside food stalls and views of the Padma are still part of a visit.

Plan your visit

Location
Louhajang, Munshiganj
How to get there
Approach via the Dhaka–Mawa corridor and use the map pin for the old ferry landing.
Access and opening hours
Use public riverfront approaches. Confirm the condition of the banks locally and keep away from unstable edges.
Bangladesh Water Development Board · Hydrological stations

Published sources reviewed 20 November 2026.

Padma riverfront

About this place

Mawa was one of the ferry approaches to the southwest before the fixed crossing opened. Today the riverbank still offers a close look at boats and changing water levels, alongside views of the bridge. Look for riverside fish meals and ask what is fresh and in season.

Use accessible public riverfront areas and avoid unprotected or eroding banks.
